products.name: Glove Box Latch & Handle
products.oemNote: Replaces OEM part 77540-S04-003ZA, confirmed discontinued by the manufacturer. Secondary-market units are scarce and carry the same age-related embrittlement as the component being replaced.
products.materialNote: Produced in engineering-grade PETG for impact resistance and cabin thermal tolerance. Build orientation is specified so the latch spring tab loads along the strongest axis rather than across a layer boundary.
description: The glove box latch is the highest-frequency interior failure on this generation. The spring tab fatigues and the handle section fractures, leaving the assembly unable to latch or unable to release. The original component is out of production; this is a direct-fit replacement engineered from the original geometry.
Installs with the original hardware. No trimming, no adapters, no modification to the lid.
features: Direct replacement for discontinued OEM part 77540-S04-003ZA
PETG construction, specified above the original ABS in the failure zone
Matte black finish specified to the factory dash appearance
products.installNote: Two fasteners from the glove box lid interior. Approximately 5–10 minutes with a Phillips driver.

products.name: HVAC Slider Lever & Knob Set
products.fitment: Fits 1996–1998 Civic (EK/EJ chassis, manual climate control)
products.oemNote: Individual knobs were never released as a service part. The only new option from the manufacturer is a complete climate control assembly, at a cost that is not proportionate to the failed component. Secondary-market supply is salvage-dependent.
products.materialNote: PETG is specified for sustained dash-top solar exposure, which exceeds the service range of PLA. Slider dimensions are held to the original track with a controlled friction fit.
description: Complete set of slider levers and knobs for the 96–98 manual climate control panel. These components crack and detach with age, and the manufacturer never offered them as a serviceable part.

Supplied as a full set for the manual HVAC panel. Press-fits onto the original lever arms. The factory face is a single flat line — this reproduction opens that face up as a design choice, at no cost difference, because it is the same print either way.
features: Complete knob set for the 96–98 manual climate control panel
Press-fit installation — no tools, no adhesive
PETG construction specified for dash-top solar exposure
Choice of knob face: classic line, or a designed face at the same price
products.installNote: Press onto the original lever arms by hand. Under a minute per knob, no tools required.
keywords: EK Civic HVAC slider knob replacement

products.name: Interior Door Handle Bezel
products.oemNote: The original bezel is a documented weak point: the thin section around the handle cup cracks with age and repeated door closure. New replacements are out of production, and secondary-market units carry the same age-related embrittlement.
products.materialNote: PETG with increased wall thickness at the crack-initiation radius — the single location where the original section was the limiting factor.
description: The surround that frames the interior door release handle. On this generation the original component embrittles and initiates cracks at the corner radius — a failure mode documented consistently across the chassis.
This reproduction retains the original mounting and visual profile while increasing section thickness at the failure point. Sold per side.
features: Direct-fit reproduction of the discontinued interior handle bezel
Reinforced corner radius at the documented crack-initiation point
Available in left-hand and right-hand versions
products.installNote: Unclips from the door card around the release handle. A trim removal tool is recommended.
keywords: EK Civic door handle trim cracked

products.name: K-Swap Underhood Plastic Guides
products.oemNote: In engineering. Specified in ASA or nylon — underhood thermal conditions exclude standard filaments.
products.materialNote: Underhood parts will ship in ASA or nylon only. PETG does not survive engine-bay heat soak.
description: Routing guides and brackets for K-series swaps — the small components swap kits omit. Underhood applications require high-temperature materials, so these are not produced in PETG.
